segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The alarm had fired repeatedly and the pattern in my head felt strong enough on its own, so I treated it as a nuisance.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant estimated the likelihood that the alarm was false from easily recalled prior nuisance alarms without checking current corroborating evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was focused on the panel itself because it was the loudest thing in the room and did not pull up the quieter pressure trend until later.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The prominent audible and visual alarm captured attention while a less salient but relevant pressure trend was overlooked.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The recent four hours looked clean, so I took the stable handover at face value and wrote off the older unresolved drift note as old news.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant overweighted the most recent stable report relative to the older unresolved drift evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I ran the standard feed-increase sequence, the same steps I had done about a hundred times, without stopping to reconsider the abnormal precursor.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A highly practiced action sequence was executed automatically without adapting it to the abnormal conditions.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The alarm, temperature climb, and shimmer reminded me of a prior compressor surge, so my instinct was to pull that same response template despite the missing vibration signature.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A superficially similar prior event was used as the diagnostic template despite the absence of a defining feature.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The tube-rupture incident felt like the more likely explanation because it was dramatic and people brought it up in every shift briefing.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The likelihood of a rare failure mode was increased because the memorable incident was socially and mentally available.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went with the first checklist option that looked workable and did not compare it with the rest because I needed something fast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Under a closing time window, the participant selected the first adequate option rather than evaluating all alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The selected action stabilized the immediate trend, but a later review found another checklist step that would have addressed the underlying issue better.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive retrospective outcome assessment without an intentionally embedded hidden bias instance.

overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate tier recovers the hidden salience, habit-intrusion, and bounded-rationality mechanisms for mechanism-first scoring. It adds no strict true positives under conservative primary-label matching, so the label taxonomy gap remains material.
main_failure_modes: Similarity Bias is classified with the neighboring representativeness heuristic label, preventing strict credit despite a full mechanism match.
Salience Bias, Habit Intrusion, and Bounded Rationality appear only as candidates and use non-equivalent primary labels.
A low-confidence overconfidence finding is unsupported as a distinct hidden instance and adds false positives at the two broadest identified-finding thresholds.
main_strengths: Both distinct Availability Bias occurrences are identified with full mechanisms and valid evidence.
Recency Bias is correctly identified and localized.
The similarity-template mechanism is accurately captured, and candidate mechanisms cover the remaining three hidden instances at the mechanism-first candidate-inclusive threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: Detection is confidence-sensitive: high-only finds one of seven instances, while high-and-moderate improves segment recall and mechanism-first instance recall. Strict performance is limited by label equivalence, and candidate inclusion closes the mechanism-first coverage gap while retaining one unsupported low-confidence false positive.
